edges.reason: Any external account may invoke withdraw; authorization is enforced internally by onlyOwner.
onlyOwner compares the stored _owner with msg.sender before executing the balance transfer.
withdraw reads address(this).balance into the local balance variable.
The cached balance determines the amount forwarded by msg.sender.transfer.
withdraw performs the external native transfer without a reentrancy guard before returning.
The recipient of the native transfer is the untrusted msg.sender.
mintPassport is publicly callable by any external account.
mintPassport requires saleIsActive to be true before minting.
mintPassport enforces totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) <= MAX_PASSPORTS.
mintPassport requires pupPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) <= msg.value.
mintPassport requires numberOfTokens <= maxPurchase.
The user-supplied numberOfTokens drives the mint loop bound and price checks.
numberOfTokens controls how many times _safeMint is executed in the loop.
mintIndex is assigned from totalSupply() inside the mint loop.
The transient mintIndex becomes the tokenId argument of _safeMint.
msg.sender is both the mint recipient and the potential onERC721Received callback target.
mintPassport calls _safeMint, which can re-enter through the ERC721 receiver hook.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received, which performs the external receiver call.
The low-level functionCall invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, handing control to external code.
setStartingIndex is publicly callable and relies on block-derived entropy for the reveal.
setStartingIndex requires startingIndexBlock to be non-zero before deriving entropy.
setStartingIndex guards on startingIndex == 0 and prevents a zero result.
startingIndex is derived from blockhash(startingIndexBlock), a manipulable block value.
The blockhash-derived value is written back into the startingIndex state variable.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is gated by onlyOwner against _owner.
Caller of emergencySetStartingIndexBlock must match the stored owner.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock sets startingIndexBlock to block.number, seeding later entropy.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, reading _owner.
transferOwnership caller must be the current owner.
newOwner parameter is validated against address(0) and written to _owner.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, reading _owner.
renounceOwnership caller must be the current owner.
setBaseURI is guarded by onlyOwner against the stored _owner.
The caller of setBaseURI must be the owner.
The baseURI parameter is forwarded into _setBaseURI.
flipSaleState is guarded by onlyOwner against the stored _owner.
The caller of flipSaleState must be the owner.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive flag that gates minting.
burn is publicly callable by any account holding or approved for the token.
The tokenId parameter is used for the approval check and the burn target.
burn reaches _burn which clears approvals and metadata for the caller-provided tokenId.
burn delegates the state destruction to the internal ERC721 _burn routine.

normalization_plan.reason: The local balance only feeds the unsafe msg.sender.transfer call in withdraw and has no independent semantic role.
numberOfTokens is a mintPassport parameter used solely as the loop bound and price-check operand.
mintIndex is a transient loop local passed directly as the tokenId argument of _safeMint.
The baseURI parameter is only consumed by setBaseURI when calling _setBaseURI.
The tokenId parameter is only consumed by burn for the approval check and _burn call.
The newOwner parameter is only consumed by transferOwnership to update _owner.
